+def test_Request_gzip_response(urlopen_mock, install_opener_mock, encoded, decompress):

+    compressed = io.BytesIO()

+    class Response(io.BytesIO):

+    compressed = io.BytesIO()

+        stream.write(content)
+    payload = compressed.getvalue() if encoded else content

+    class Response(io.BytesIO):
+        @property

+

+            return {'Content-Encoding': 'gzip' if encoded else 'identity', 'Content-Length': str(len(payload))}
+
+    response = Response(payload)
+    urlopen_mock.return_value = response
+    result = Request().open('GET', 'http://ansible.com/', decompress=decompress)
+    assert result.fp is response
+    assert result.read() == (content if encoded and decompress else payload)

+    assert response.closed
